# M9-S1 lint leg of --pedantic (flag wiring: M0-S7): logos lint accepts the
# flag, a default build stays silent for the pedantic group, and --pedantic
# enables it. The rule itself is proved in M9-S2.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# Default logos lint and logos build are silent for the pedantic group.
cd union
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
logos build -o $WORK/bin/union$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/union$GOEXE
cd ..

# logos lint --pedantic accepts the flag and reports the default clause of
# the switch over the closed union as a warning.
cd union
logos lint --pedantic ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:15:2: warning: \[pedantic::exhaustive_union_switch\]'
cd ..

# logos build --pedantic enables the group too, without failing the build.
cd union
logos build --pedantic -o $WORK/bin/unionped$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:15:2: warning: \[pedantic::exhaustive_union_switch\]'
exists $WORK/bin/unionped$GOEXE
cd ..

# --pedantic=false stays silent and a bad value fails at the flag layer.
cd union
logos lint --pedantic=false ./...
! stderr .
! logos lint --pedantic=maybe ./...
stderr '^invalid boolean value "maybe" for -pedantic'
cd ..

# The warning is a lint diagnostic in the JSON output;
# TestLogosJSONDiagnostics checks the record as JSON.
cd union
logos lint --pedantic --json-diagnostics ./...
cd ..

# A switch without default stays silent under --pedantic.
cd exhaustive
logos lint --pedantic ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# logos.toml pedantic = "deny" makes the group an error without the flag,
# and --pedantic=false overrides the key.
cd strict
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:15:2: \[pedantic::exhaustive_union_switch\]'
logos lint --pedantic=false ./...
! stderr .
! logos lint --pedantic ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:15:2: \[pedantic::exhaustive_union_switch\]'
cd ..

# The pedantic rule never applies to Go packages.
cd gopkg
logos lint --pedantic ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# Plain go keeps the unknown-flag error for the logos-only flags.
cd union
! go build --pedantic .
stderr '^flag provided but not defined: -pedantic'
cd ..

-- union/go.mod --
module example.com/union

go 1.27

-- union/main.lgo --
package main

type Shape interface {
	Circle | Square
}

type Circle struct{ r int }

type Square struct{ s int }

func area(sh Shape) int {
	switch v := sh.(type) {
	case Circle:
		return v.r
	default:
		return 0
	}
}

func main() {
	println(area(Circle{1}))
}

-- exhaustive/go.mod --
module example.com/exhaustive

go 1.27

-- exhaustive/main.lgo --
package main

type Shape interface {
	Circle | Square
}

type Circle struct{ r int }

type Square struct{ s int }

func area(sh Shape) int {
	switch v := sh.(type) {
	case Circle:
		return v.r
	case Square:
		return v.s
	case nil:
		return 0
	}
	return -1
}

func main() {
	println(area(Circle{1}))
}

-- strict/go.mod --
module example.com/strict

go 1.27

-- strict/logos.toml --
[lints]
pedantic = "deny"

-- strict/main.lgo --
package main

type Shape interface {
	Circle | Square
}

type Circle struct{ r int }

type Square struct{ s int }

func area(sh Shape) int {
	switch v := sh.(type) {
	case Circle:
		return v.r
	default:
		return 0
	}
}

func main() {
	println(area(Circle{1}))
}

-- gopkg/go.mod --
module example.com/gopkg

go 1.27

-- gopkg/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func kind(v any) string {
	switch v.(type) {
	case int:
		return "int"
	default:
		return "other"
	}
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(kind(1))
}
